newsitem.title: USA: Keithley sees return to profitability in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Keithley sees return to profitability in Q3.

text.p: Keithley Instruments Inc said Thursday it expects to return to profitability in the third quarter, after the company reported a second quarter loss of $0.04 a share on lower sales of $28.1 million.
In the 1996 second quarter, the company reported a profit of $0.19 a share on sales of $30 million.

"Although we're disappointed with our loss, it was in line with expectations," the company said in a release. "We continue to believe in our growth strategies and expect to return to profitability in the third quarter. We have begun to see signs that the worst of the semiconductor capital equipment industry slump may be behind us as orders have recently improved."
